cards.text: Sorry to bring it up. Could the veins beat our usual ten-day yield, just over it? Archie has more calc to sell and James has more to craft with, and it's the quickest way I know to give them both.

cards.text: I'm sorry, I know it's not my place. I'd like the yield to finish this week above our ten-day average. Not by much. Every bit over is calc Archie can sell and James can work, so it's worth a try.

cards.text: If it's all right, I'd like to try for a yield past our ten-day average. I'm sorry, I'll say it plainly: just over. More calc out of the veins means more on Archie's table and more on James's bench.

cards.text: Sorry, this might be daft. Could we aim for a little above our ten-day yield? I'd tend the veins closer to get it. Extra calc is something Archie and James would both use.
